plugin.name: Notes
plugin.description: Write markdown notes for each host, folder or yourself, with commands you can copy or send to the terminal.

use.title: Use Notes
use.description: Read and write notes on hosts you can access and keep your own global notes.

enable.label: Notes
enable.description: Show Notes for this host in its menu.

showPanel.label: Panel beside the terminal
showPanel.description: Offer a notes panel next to this host's SSH terminal.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the notes panel with a terminal
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the notes panel when a terminal opens on a host that has it.

companionSide.label: Notes panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits next to the terminal.

companionSize.label: Notes panel size
companionSize.description: Width, or height at the bottom, in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Notes panel edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the terminal edge to open the panel.

hint.host: Notes for this host. Anyone with access to it can read them.
hint.folder: Notes for every host in this folder.
hint.global: Private notes that belong to you, not to a host.

code.sent: Sent to the terminal. Press Enter to run it.

editor.title: Title
editor.bodyPlaceholder: Write in markdown. Fenced code blocks get Copy and Send buttons.
editor.pick: Pick a note or make a new one

card.title: Pinned notes
card.empty: No pinned notes. Pin a private note to see it here.
